auth.title: Admin panel
auth.subtitle: Sign in to manage your catalog.

dashboard.next: Management sections arrive in the next phases.
dashboard.pickTenant: To manage a business's catalog, enter its tenant with the “Enter” button in the Tenants list.
dashboard.insideTenant: You are inside the tenant “{{slug}}”. Its products, categories and settings arrive in the next phases.

errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.

unsaved.title: Leave without saving?
unsaved.body: There are unsaved changes. If you leave, they will be lost.

tenants.title: Tenants
tenants.name: Name
tenants.createError: The tenant could not be created.
tenants.templateNote: It is created with an initial configuration: shop closed, delivery off, standard currency and languages, and the “classic” palette. Everything can be adjusted later in Settings.

fields.name: Business name
fields.whatsappHint: Receives the orders. With country code, digits only.
fields.slugHint: Permanent identifier: it cannot be changed later.
fields.customDomainHint: Optional. Without a domain the catalog cannot show this tenant; it can be added later.
fields.cloudinaryNote: Account shared by all tenants. Changing the cloud name breaks existing images.
fields.servesCuisineHint: Only applies to food businesses. Type and press Enter to add each one.
fields.openingHoursHint: One per line, Google format (e.g. Mo-Fr 09:00-18:00).
fields.countryHint: Pick the country from the list (type the first letters to find it).

errors.whatsapp: Digits only, with country code (8 to 15 digits).
errors.slug: Use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (2 to 50 characters).
errors.domain: Enter only the domain, e.g. menu.mybusiness.com.
errors.duplicate: A tenant with that value already exists.
errors.duplicateSlug: A tenant with the slug “{{slug}}” already exists. Pick another.
errors.duplicateDomain: A tenant with the domain “{{domain}}” already exists.
errors.duplicateEither: A tenant with the slug “{{slug}}” or the domain “{{domain}}” already exists.
errors.color: Use a hex color, for example #0f6b57.
errors.cloudId: Only letters, numbers, hyphen, underscore, dot and slash.
errors.domainLocked: This tenant already has a domain: you can change it but not leave it empty.
errors.coordLocked: This value was already set: it can be changed but not left empty.

placeholders.name: e.g. My Restaurant
placeholders.title: e.g. My Business | Digital Menu
placeholders.description: e.g. Browse our menu and order online.

confirmCreate.title: Create the tenant?
confirmCreate.body: “{{name}}” will be created with the slug “{{slug}}”. The slug cannot be changed later.

tenants.createErrorDetail: The tenant could not be created. {{detail}}
tenants.updateError: The tenant could not be saved.
tenants.updateErrorDetail: The tenant could not be saved. {{detail}}

edit.title: Edit tenant
edit.notFound: This tenant does not exist or was deleted.
edit.statusHint: A suspended tenant stops being available in the catalog.
edit.domainHint: It already has a domain: it can be changed but not left empty.
edit.seoHint: IDs are the public Cloudinary identifiers of each image.
edit.noChanges: There are no changes to save.
edit.cloudWarning: Warning: changing the cloud name breaks all existing images of this tenant.

prefs.title: Preferences
prefs.animationsHint: Turn them off if you prefer an interface without motion.

tooltips.save: Saves the changes and keeps you on this screen to continue editing.
tooltips.saveBack: Saves the changes and goes back to the tenants list.
tooltips.cancel: Discards what you haven't saved and goes back to the list.
tooltips.create: Creates the tenant. You will be asked to confirm first.
tooltips.edit: Edit the tenant's data: name, plan, texts, SEO and more.
tooltips.enter: Enter this tenant to manage its products, categories and settings.
tooltips.current: You are already inside this tenant.
tooltips.generatePassword: Generates a strong password and shows it so you can copy it.
tooltips.copyPassword: Copies the password to the clipboard so you can share it securely.
tooltips.addUser: Create a person who can sign in and manage this tenant.
tooltips.unlock: Removes the lockout from failed attempts so they can sign in again.
tooltips.deactivate: Stops this person from signing in. Nothing is deleted and it can be reactivated.
tooltips.activate: Lets this person sign in again.

access.title: Access
access.subtitle: People who can sign in and manage this tenant.
access.empty: There are no users for this tenant yet.
access.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. It is temporary: share it securely.
access.copyError: The password could not be copied.
access.createError: The user could not be created.
access.createErrorDetail: The user could not be created. {{detail}}

errors.password: The password must be 8 to 72 characters long.
errors.duplicate: A user with that email already exists.
errors.duplicateEmail: A user with the email “{{email}}” already exists.

confirmDeactivate.title: Deactivate the user?
